body.text: Across modern technology, few developments carry as much structural weight as Confidential Computing. When examined through the lens of supply chain constraints, the gap between surface-level headlines and operational reality becomes unmistakable.

Rather than treating Confidential Computing as an isolated upgrade, leading researchers and operators integrate it into a cohesive system. Every design choice involves explicit trade-offs between throughput, resilience, and simplicity.

body.text: True progress in technology rarely comes from complexity alone; it emerges when Confidential Computing makes essential work measurably clearer and more reliable.
